The plan recorded for cell `plan`, as `relate --mode table` prints it:

```text
Query: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Ada'})-[:WORKS_ON]->(r:Project) RETURN r.name AS project
Plan:
+------------------+----+-------------------------------------+
| Operator         | Id | Details                             |
+------------------+----+-------------------------------------+
| + ProduceResults | 0  | 1 item(s)                           |
+------------------+----+-------------------------------------+
| | + Expand       | 1  | (r:Project)<-[:WORKS_ON]-(p:Person) |
+------------------+----+-------------------------------------+
Notifications:
Id 1: INFORMATION 03C91 Relate.Notification.Statement.MissingIndex: the equality predicate on name filters :Person without a range index on (:Person {name}) Remedy: CREATE INDEX relate_Person__name FOR (n:Person) ON (n.name)
```

Notifications, each with its remedy:

- [`03C91` Missing index](/docs/reference/errors#notif-03c91) on operator 1: the equality predicate on name filters :Person without a range index on (:Person {name}). Remedy: `CREATE INDEX relate_Person__name FOR (n:Person) ON (n.name)`

In a browser, the viewer's comparison runs `CREATE INDEX relate_Person__name FOR (n:Person) ON (n.name)` on the page's in-memory database only.
